en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Yaqteen, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Happiness of a person is that he does not die until he sees a successor from himself’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salmah ibn al-Khattab from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from Yunus ibn Ya’qub from a man who has said the following: “I once heard abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘
Fortunate is the man who does not die before seeing a successor of his own self.’”
